Refinished floors, without the dust cloud.

Our sanders hook straight into a high-powered vacuum system that pulls the dust in at the source. It never makes it into your air, your vents, or onto your furniture.

  • At the sanderDust is captured as the floor is sanded, not swept up afterward.
  • Your HVACFine dust stays out of your ducts and filters.
  • Free estimatesWe come to your home, look at the floor, and give you a real number.

Hardwood floors, redefined.

Refinishing, installation, staircases, and repairs. Our own crew does the work, from the first sanding pass to the final coat.

Hardwood floor refinishing

Worn, scratched, or dull floors sanded back to bare wood and finished like new. Keep the natural color or pick a new stain.

  • Dustless sanding to bare wood
  • Custom stain colors
  • Durable protective finish

Hardwood floor installation

Solid and engineered hardwood installed by our own crew, from classic oak to wide plank, with clean transitions between rooms.

  • Solid and engineered hardwood
  • Residential and commercial
  • Free in-home estimate

Commercial spaces

Hardwood for lobbies, offices, and other business spaces, installed and finished by the same crew.

Whole-home floors

One consistent floor from room to room, with clean transitions at every doorway.

Borders and inlays

Accents that set a room apart and follow the shape of your space.
